description: Na₂Nd₄NOCl₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.80-3.08 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.06 Å. There are four inequivalent Nd sites. In the first Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and six Cl atoms. The Nd-N bond length is 2.31 Å. The Nd-O bond length is 2.36 Å. There are a spread of Nd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.18 Å. In the second Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and seven Cl atoms. The Nd-N bond length is 2.34 Å. The Nd-O bond length is 2.31 Å. There are a spread of Nd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.37 Å. In the third Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and seven Cl atoms. The Nd-N bond length is 2.27 Å. The Nd-O bond length is 2.39 Å. There are a spread of Nd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.37 Å. In the fourth Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and six Cl atoms. The Nd-N bond length is 2.32 Å. The Nd-O bond length is 2.37 Å. There are a spread of Nd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.09 Å. N is bonded to four Nd atoms to form NNd₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent ONd₄ tetrahedra. O is bonded to four Nd atoms to form ONd₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent NNd₄ tetrahedra. There are nine inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Nd atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na and four Nd atoms. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na and four Nd atoms. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Nd atoms. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Nd atoms. In the sixth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Nd atoms. In the seventh Cl site, Cl is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Nd atoms. In the eighth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Nd atoms. In the ninth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Nd atoms.
